meta.title: Alpha Agent for OrthoWorks® — AI That Runs Your Practice
meta.description: See how Alpha Agent helps OrthoWorks automate patient communication, streamline scheduling, and reduce front-desk overhead across 11 Bay Area locations.

hero.headline: Your AI assistant for every location, every patient.
hero.subheadline: OrthoWorks runs 11 locations, 7 specialists, and 60,000+ patients across the Bay Area. Alpha Agent handles the operational overhead — so your team can focus on beautiful smiles.

pain_points.label: The Challenge
pain_points.title: Multi-location orthodontics is operationally complex
pain_points.subtitle: Every location means more calls, more scheduling conflicts, and more admin pulling your team away from patient care.

items.title: Overwhelmed Front Desks
items.body: Staff across 11 locations spend hours answering the same questions — hours, insurance, Invisalign pricing, availability.

items.title: Scheduling Chaos
items.body: Coordinating 7 specialists across 11 offices creates constant back-and-forth. Patients fall through the cracks.

items.title: Follow-Up Gaps
items.body: Post-consultation follow-ups and recall campaigns get deprioritized when the front desk is buried in daily ops.

items.title: No Unified View
items.body: Patient data in one system, scheduling in another, marketing in a third. No single view across all locations.

solutions.label: How Alpha Agent Helps
solutions.title: One AI assistant across every OrthoWorks location

items.title: 24/7 Patient Communication
items.body: Alpha answers patient questions instantly — treatment options, Invisalign FAQs, insurance details, office hours, directions — via your website, SMS, or WhatsApp. Your front desk handles fewer routine calls.
items.tag: Reduces call volume by up to 40%

items.title: Smart Multi-Location Scheduling
items.body: Patients request appointments naturally. Alpha checks Dr. Shen and all 7 specialists' availability across every Bay Area location, suggests the nearest open slot, and books it. No phone tag.
items.tag: Works with your existing scheduling system

items.title: Automated Follow-Ups & Recalls
items.body: Post-consultation follow-ups, treatment milestone reminders, 6-month recall notices — Alpha sends them on schedule via SMS or email, personalized per patient. Nothing falls through the cracks.

items.title: Cross-Location Insights
items.body: One dashboard across all 11 locations. Booking trends, consultation conversion rates, Invisalign vs. braces mix, staff utilization. Alpha surfaces insights you'd never find manually.

items.title: Internal Team Assistant
items.body: "What's our cancellation policy?" "When is Dr. Shen in Sunnyvale next?" "Pull up the Invisalign pricing sheet." Your staff asks Alpha anything — it knows your practice inside and out.
